title: Mirrors
content: Hi guys! I’m new to this sub and it’s my first time posting here so I apologize if this isn’t the right place for this, but I was curious if anyone else has had experience with looking into mirrors in their dreams. It’s only happened to me a total of 2 times that I can remember - once last night, and once around a year or 2 ago. In both dreams, I was looking at myself and saw myself as an older, prettier version of myself. Both times I woke up very quickly after seeing myself, but I find it very interesting. Am I seeing a future/higher version of myself, potentially? A super cool thought even if not!
